body:
## Summary for non-engineers
- Postbox repeats several checks in one run.
- Run each check once, keeping full coverage.
- No new machines or paid services.

Ticket: https://app.hypertask.ai/detail/project-11514/143

## Change
Preflight already runs Python tooling discovery, cache-key validation, outbox lifecycle negative controls, PR-ref fetching and the four agent guards removed here. Keep that fail-fast step intact, remove duplicate workflow invocations, and retain the three release/review guards not included in preflight. ARM64, historical archive controls, artifacts, triggers and other jobs are unchanged.

## Timing evidence
**Postbox ci execution: 796 seconds before → 597 seconds after**, one successful run per side (199 seconds less, 25.0%). This is an observed single-pair result, not a reproducible median or proof that the slowdown alarm recovered.

- Before: https://github.com/valentinyeo/postbox/actions/runs/42257181979 — exact parent cc45db5d34dd30065a2340a79845cb4ba38fb27a, 16:57:41–17:10:57 UTC.
- After: https://github.com/valentinyeo/postbox/actions/runs/42258407065 — PR head 3cab0aee9959d1f9021e294fe37896e8220cc422, 17:05:35–17:15:32 UTC.
- Same app source, Zig 0.16.0 and hosted runner label; only ci.yml differs. Execution excludes queue delay. Runs overlap on distinct GitHub machines, so machine/cache variability remains a confounder.
- Before duplicated Python discovery took 152 seconds; standalone outbox controls took 30 seconds; agent guards took 21 seconds versus 4 seconds for the retained unique guards. These removed step costs total 199 seconds. Remaining preflight was nearly unchanged (486 → 484 seconds), as was ARM64 (70 → 68 seconds). Preflight remains the limiting serial stage.
- Earlier exploratory baseline https://github.com/valentinyeo/postbox/actions/runs/42238283077 was 524 seconds, versus 597 seconds after. Its app source differs (cfc8d6b), so it is not the matching-parent comparison and cannot support a speedup claim.

## Coverage and review
All seven jobs in the changed ci workflow succeeded, including Windows smoke, caption, unfurl, ARM64 compilation and historical archive controls. Current-head metadata checks also passed.

The advisory review's omitted-coverage concerns are disproved by the after-run Preflight log: Python discovery executes 340 tests (one existing skip), outbox runtime executes with --negative-controls, cache-key validation executes, PR refs are fetched, and test-preflight-guard.sh, test-agent-setup.sh, test-lint-repeats.sh and test-ci-green.sh all execute. The separate release/review guard step retains test-auto-release-pick.sh, test-automerge-admit.sh and test-ai-review.sh. No local builds or tests were run.

This is NOT ready for unattended automerge: tools/automerge-admit.sh requires notify-release, which is absent from the current-head rollup; it also excludes bot-authored PRs and requires manual review for ci.yml changes. Do not bypass those gates. Independent review and the existing merge policy remain required.

Android already has cancellation and broad path filters. Per-phone dependency filtering and a full quiet day for both apps remain unproved. This PR does not complete the entire ticket.

Card: none
